verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents metadata filtering through SQL-like `where(...)` predicates, including pre-filtering before vector search, and community users note predicate pushdown. Its SQL expressions also reach nested struct fields such as `stats.strength`, and predicate strings like `role = 'Traitor Knight'` appear in its examples. Nothing in the pack shows the specific rich conditions the story names, so coverage is only partial. Missing for 10: range filters on metadata (the [0.0, 0.5) example filters vector distance, not metadata), geo/spatial filters, nested boolean (AND/OR/NOT) logic, array-membership operators, and an operator reference or hands-on corroboration of complex filters.
